description: Saves an audience for campaigns, with a name, the WhatsApp number it is for and who it names (contact tags, that number’s chat labels and up to 10 contact-field conditions, any or all), and returns it with its id, the audience.segment_id a campaign takes. A condition is a contact field of the business, or name, locale or timezone, with is, is_not or contains for text, is, gt or lt for a number, before, after or on for a date, is or is_not for a choice (one of its choices), is for a yes/no field (true or false), or is_set or is_not_set. It sends nothing and messages nobody. The audience is on the Campaigns page of the Cosend dashboard too. Campaigns are on the Starter plan and above, and for owners and admins.

fields.description: Contact-field conditions, at most 10: key is a contact field of the business, or name, locale or timezone; op is is, is_not or contains for text, is, gt or lt for a number, before, after or on for a date (YYYY-MM-DD), is or is_not for a choice (value one of its choices), is for a yes/no field (value true or false), and is_set or is_not_set for any field.

name: create_audience
title: Save an audience for campaigns
